title: Route decisions and backlog to the control-root store in a granted worktree
action: Per D6 (issues 97, 105, 110, 114). Today `decisions_prelude_at` in verbs/decisions/verbs_write.rs resolves `crate::roots::resolve_store_root_any(start)` and backlog.rs imports `resolve_store_root_any as resolve_store_root`; for a GRANTED worktree that returns the worktree's own store, so decisions and PBIs logged there never reach the control-root store the claim door, dispatch and cells add read. `pub(crate) fn resolve_root_serving_granted(cwd: &Path) -> (Roots, Option<PathBuf>)` in verbs/drivers/prepare.rs already maps a granted worktree to `Roots::Ordinary(main_root)` and is the door cells add and dispatch prepare use. Call it (take `.0`) in `decisions_prelude_at` and in backlog.rs's `preamble` in place of the WIDE door; do not edit prepare.rs (a sibling cell owns it). Delete comment lines that are now false in those two files and in the roots.rs door audit (the lines that list decisions/backlog as WIDE-door, grant-local stores); add no new comments. Red first: in verbs/decisions/tests.rs, near the existing granted-worktree fixtures (rg -n "granted" verbs/decisions/tests.rs), add a test that runs decisions_prelude_at from a granted worktree and asserts the root is the main checkout; update any existing test that pinned the worktree-local store to the new contract. Add a matching backlog test in backlog.rs's test module if one exists for its preamble, else a test that backlog's root resolution from a granted worktree is the main checkout using the same fixture shape. No code comments. If cargo fails to compile in a file outside your files list, a sibling cell is mid-edit: wait 60 seconds and re-run; never edit that file. The existing test `decisions_log_and_active_succeed_against_a_granted_worktrees_own_store` in verbs/decisions/tests.rs pins the old contract: invert it so it asserts the event lands in the main checkout's store. Known limit, do not fix here: the session preamble and status decision reads still use the worktree store root; record it in the report deviations.
